Summary: Payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement for an IPC, or from the date of submission of the Final Payment Certificate for Works.
Quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.4 for an IPC
Notes: Excerpt also mentions part payment recommendations within 10 days of receipt under clause 19.5, but the primary payment term for amounts due under payment certificates is 30 days under Clause 19.9.

Summary: The Authority shall deduct 6% from every payment for Works as Retention Money, subject to a maximum cap of 5% of the Contract Price.
Quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
Notes: Deduction is 6% per bill, but capped at an overall maximum of 5% of the Contract Price.

Summary: An interest-bearing advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses, made in two instalments of 5% each.
Quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “Advance Payment”) @ “Bank Rate + 3%”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisation expenses.
Notes: The advance payment carries interest at Bank Rate + 3% and is made in two equal instalments of 5% each. An additional 5% equipment advance is also available.

Summary: The contractor shall pay damages of 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay in achieving any Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date.
Quote: In the event that the Contractor fails to achieve any Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date within a period of 30 (thirty) days from the date set forth in Schedule-J, unless such failure has occurred due to Force Majeure or for reasons solely attributable to the Authority, it shall pay Damages to the Authority of a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five percent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule –J and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Project Highway is completed
Notes: Clause number is implied by context on page 67. Also mentions a lane closure maintenance delay penalty on page 89 (0.1% of monthly maintenance payment), but the primary contractor completion delay penalty is 0.05% of the Contract Price per day.

Summary: The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works and Maintenance shall be adjusted for changes in rates and prices of inputs in accordance with the prescribed formulae.
Quote:
19.10  Price adjustment for the Works
(i)
The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works shall be adjusted in accordance
with the provisions of this Clause 19.10
Notes: Price adjustment applies to both the Works (Clause 19.10) and Maintenance of the Project Highway (Clause 19.12) using specified input component percentages and formulae.

Summary: The contractor must furnish an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee for the Performance Security equal to 3% of the Bid Price, valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period.
Quote: the selected Bidder shall furnish to the Authority an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-G (the “Performance Security”) for an amount equal to 3% (Three percent) of its Bid Price.
Notes: The Performance Security must be an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee for 3% of the Bid Price, valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period. Additional Performance Security may also apply depending on the bid price.
